inputs.note: Multi-analyte lab samples for the document side; a real lexical retrieval for the guideline side, where a fusion step emitting the same chunk twice is the equivalent failure.

expected: In a multi-analyte report every row cites its own field_or_chunk_id and every test_key is unique; no two rows share a citation.
guards_against: Repeated-entity collapse on a dense table: 44 rows that all cite row 1 look complete and are not.
